description: One connection of an agent graph: who called whom, how often and when it happened last. The record is a VALUE — an AgentGraphCall event folds into it through AgentGraphSnapshot.Apply, which returns a new snapshot instead of editing this edge. CallCount is what the surface turns into a THICKNESS on a log scale, so a quiet connection stays visible instead of disappearing next to a busy one, and LastCallAt is what it prints. Nothing here carries colour: the direction of the flow is painted by the edge itself and the identity by the two nodes it connects.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the edge — the value an AgentGraphCall addresses. Never empty: a missing id is generated at construction.

members.name: From
members.description: The id of the node the call starts at.

members.name: To
members.description: The id of the node the call goes to. Equal to From is a self loop — one agent calling itself — which the layout paints beside the node instead of dropping.

members.name: CallCount
members.description: How many calls this connection carried. Any negative value is clamped to zero on assignment, so an edge only ever grows and a thickness can never be derived from a negative number. Zero paints the thinnest width.

members.name: LastCallAt
members.description: When the newest call was recorded, or null when the host does not track it. A surface prints it when it is set and the localized "never" otherwise.

members.name: IsActive
members.description: Whether the connection is active right now (a call is in flight, the tool is being held). Default false; a surface paints an active edge with its accent, an inactive one without.

members.name: IsSelfLoop
members.description: Whether the edge starts and ends at the same node.
